description.html: This 32x20x25 cm terrarium (16 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

With a floor area of 32x20 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh ventilation openings provide the airflow animals need to stay healthy and prevent condensation.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
